"""End-to-end: run the frozen submission as the bounded child and verify output."""
import json, os, random, shutil, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import public_check
from brute import brute_batch
from gen2 import gen2_batch
from fuzz4 import enrich

scratch = Path('/workspace/tmp')
scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='e2e-', dir=scratch))
frozen = root / 'submission'
public_check.freeze(Path('/workspace/submission'), frozen)

# a protocol-shaped batch: 3 jobs, small universes so the naive reference is feasible
rng = random.Random(20240607)
batch = gen2_batch(rng, jobs=3, max_universe=200, width=4, P=9, n_queries=10)
want = enrich(batch, rng)
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data))

cwd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='case-', dir=root))
t = time.time()
got = public_check.capture(frozen / 'main.py', data, cwd)
print('child wall %.2fs' % (time.time() - t))
print('match:', got == want)
if got != want:
    print(json.dumps(got)[:2000])
    print(json.dumps(want)[:2000])

# a maximal batch (no reference check, only limits/timing/serialization)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
from stress import make_job, usize
jobs = []
for sizes, K, seed in (([2] * 16, 1, 1), ([256, 256], 1, 2)):
    jobs.append(make_job(sizes, K, 32, 4, 10000, 128, 'random', seed=seed))
big = {'jobs': jobs}
data = json.dumps(big).encode()
print('big input bytes', len(data), 'sum U', sum(usize(*c[:2]) for c in (( [2]*16,1), ([256,256],1))))
cwd2 = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='case2-', dir=root))
t = time.time()
out = public_check.capture(frozen / 'main.py', data, cwd2)
print('big child wall %.2fs results=%d out bytes=%d' % (time.time() - t, len(out['results']), len(json.dumps(out))))
print('rules per job', [len(r['rules']) for r in out['results']], 'answers', [len(r['answers']) for r in out['results']])
shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
PYEOF
